points.K1: 激光加工设备的五类危险
points.K2: 先培训考核授权，再上机

points.K4: 预约签到，到场接受检查

points.K11: 运行全程一臂之内看守
points.K14: 卡丝、焊枪故障：先停光再处理
points.K15: 手伸进机内前停光，取件防割防烫

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在工程训练中心的激光切割机旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed desktop laser cutter in an engineering training workshop, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光加工设备的安全操作。
overlay: 激光加工设备安全操作

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰按下启动键，转身去窗边看手机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the start button on a laser cutter, then turns away to look at his phone by the window.
shots.narration: 阿杰开机切木板，转身去看手机。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 机盖里冒出一小簇火苗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small flame flickering up inside the closed lid of the laser cutter. No text.
shots.narration: 机器里冒出了火苗。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研冲过去按下停止键，机盖保持关闭
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rushes over and presses the stop button, keeping the lid closed.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧按停：运行时人不能走。

shots.section_title: 激光加工设备的五类危险
shots.scene: 激光切割机周围五个危险图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser cutting machine surrounded by five hazard icons, a beam, a flame, smoke, a gas cylinder and a lightning bolt. No text.
shots.narration: 激光加工设备，至少有五类危险。
overlay: 激光加工设备的五类危险

shots.section_title: 激光加工设备的五类危险
shots.scene: 光束伤眼和皮肤，火花溅到纸上起火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam reaching an eye and a hand, and sparks landing on paper that catches fire. No text.
shots.narration: 激光伤眼伤皮肤，火花高温会引火。

shots.section_title: 激光加工设备的五类危险
shots.scene: 烟尘进肺，旁边是气瓶和高压电符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: smoke drawn into a pair of lungs, beside a gas cylinder and a high voltage symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 烟尘伤肺，还有高压气体和高压电。

shots.section_title: 激光加工设备的五类危险
shots.scene: 运动的横梁夹住手，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a moving gantry of a cutting machine pinching a hand, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 运动的横梁，还会夹手撞人。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核授权，再上机
shots.scene: 王老师在工程训练中心给学生上准入培训
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator gives an induction training session to students in an engineering training workshop.
shots.narration: 上机前，先参加准入培训。
overlay: 先培训考核授权，再上机

shots.section_title: 先培训考核授权，再上机
shots.scene: 考核合格，阿杰拿到空白授权卡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a passed test paper with a tick and a blank authorisation card handed to a student. No text.
shots.narration: 考核通过、获得授权，才能使用。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核授权，再上机
shots.scene: 空白预约表和登记本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank booking calendar and a sign in logbook beside a laser machine. No text.
shots.narration: 每次使用，按规定预约登记。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核授权，再上机
shots.scene: 第一次上手，王老师站在旁边指导
shots.prompt_en: The young male student uses a laser cutter for the first time while the safety administrator stands beside him guiding.
shots.narration: 第一次上手，要有老师在旁指导。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核授权，再上机
shots.scene: 陌生设备前的手打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand reaching toward an unfamiliar laser machine, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 没授权、不熟悉的设备，不碰。

shots.section_title: 资格考核：测验、手册和上机作品
shots.scene: 电脑上的安全测验，没过就复习再考
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety quiz on a computer screen with a retry arrow pointing back to a study book. No text.
shots.narration: 先完成安全测验，没过就复习再考。
overlay: 资格考核：测验、手册和上机作品

shots.section_title: 资格考核：测验、手册和上机作品
shots.scene: 翻开空白的培训手册
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open training handbook with blank pages and a bookmark. No text.
shots.narration: 培训手册随时可查，忘了就翻。

shots.section_title: 资格考核：测验、手册和上机作品
shots.scene: 阿杰独立完成一把刻度尺作品
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up a small engraved wooden ruler he made by himself, the safety administrator nodding.
shots.narration: 再独立完成一件上机考核作品。

shots.section_title: 资格考核：测验、手册和上机作品
shots.scene: 授权名单上加了一个勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank authorised user list with a new tick added and a small badge icon. No text.
shots.narration: 通过了，才有这台设备的使用资格。

shots.section_title: 预约签到，到场接受检查
shots.scene: 预约日历上先约考核，再约日常使用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a booking calendar with a first slot for the assessment and later slots for normal use. No text.
shots.narration: 先考核，有资格才能预约日常使用。
overlay: 预约签到，到场接受检查

shots.section_title: 预约签到，到场接受检查
shots.scene: 预约表上两个勾选框：承诺书、培训
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a booking form with two check boxes, one beside a signed pledge icon and one beside a training icon. No text.
shots.narration: 预约时确认签了承诺书、受过培训。

shots.section_title: 预约签到，到场接受检查
shots.scene: 服务台签到，小研查看材料和手续
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs in at a service desk while the female graduate student checks his material and paperwork.
shots.narration: 到场先签到，管理人员查材料和手续。

shots.section_title: 读懂安全须知，严格遵守
shots.scene: 阿杰认真读安全须知
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carefully reads a blank safety instruction sheet beside the laser machine.
shots.narration: 用设备前，先读懂安全须知。
overlay: 读懂安全须知，严格遵守

shots.section_title: 读懂安全须知，严格遵守
shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，小研解答
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand with a question and the female graduate student explains.
shots.narration: 不懂就问，确认后再开工。

shots.section_title: 读懂安全须知，严格遵守
shots.scene: 规矩清单旁边，安全装置罩着防尘罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist with ticks beside safety devices that stay unused under a dust cover. No text.
shots.narration: 守好规矩，安全装置最好永远用不上。

shots.section_title: 开机前点检与穿戴
shots.scene: 空白点检卡和笔
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank pre-start checklist card and a pen clipped to the laser machine. No text.
shots.narration: 每次开机前，按点检卡看一遍。

shots.section_title: 开机前点检与穿戴
shots.scene: 【实拍】按点检卡逐项检查急停按钮、机盖和排烟净化器开关（设备不出光，遮挡品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand ticking a checklist while checking the emergency stop button, the lid and the fume extractor switch of a laser machine.
shots.narration: 急停、钥匙、线缆、外壳、气源都看。

shots.section_title: 开机前点检与穿戴
shots.scene: 打开排烟净化器，扫净机内碎屑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume extractor switched on and scrap pieces swept out of the machine bed. No text.
shots.narration: 排烟净化先打开，机内碎屑清干净。

shots.section_title: 开机前点检与穿戴
shots.scene: 【实拍】操作者站在工位，伸手指认急停按钮（设备待机）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: an operator standing at the machine and reaching a hand to the emergency stop button.
shots.narration: 认清急停在哪，伸手就能按到。

shots.section_title: 开机前点检与穿戴
shots.scene: 发送前确认：设备选对、盖子关好、材料放平
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three checks before sending a job, the right machine selected, the lid closed and the sheet lying flat. No text.
shots.narration: 发送前确认选对设备，盖关好、料放平。

shots.section_title: 开机前点检与穿戴
shots.scene: 点检卡上一项打叉，阿杰去找老师
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one item on the checklist crossed, and a student walking to a teacher instead of switching on. No text.
shots.narration: 有一项不对，先不开机，报告老师。

shots.section_title: 开机前点检与穿戴
shots.scene: 手持焊接前穿防护服、围裙、手套，戴防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a protective jacket, an apron, gloves and laser safety goggles before handheld welding.
shots.narration: 手持焊接，穿戴齐全，皮肤不外露。

shots.section_title: 开机前点检与穿戴
shots.scene: 焊接工位上方的排风罩在工作
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an exhaust hood working above a welding station, air flowing out of the room. No text.
shots.narration: 工作间要保持通风良好。

shots.section_title: 出光口不对人，焊枪用完挂好
shots.scene: 焊枪出光口对着人体，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a handheld laser welding torch nozzle pointing at a person's body, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 出光口不对着身体任何部位。
overlay: 出光口不对人，焊枪用完挂好

shots.section_title: 出光口不对人，焊枪用完挂好
shots.scene: 试机时枪口朝向工件，旁人在围挡外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding torch pointing down at a workpiece during a test, other people standing outside a screen. No text.
shots.narration: 有没有出光，枪口都朝向工件。

shots.section_title: 出光口不对人，焊枪用完挂好
shots.scene: 送丝时枪口朝下，人从侧面看，不正对焊嘴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a torch pointing down at the bench while wire feeds out, the operator watching from the side, a face in front of the nozzle crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 送丝时，脸别正对焊嘴。

shots.section_title: 出光口不对人，焊枪用完挂好
shots.scene: 【实拍】焊接结束，把焊枪挂回挂架（设备不出光）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand hanging a handheld welding torch back on its holder.
shots.narration: 焊枪用完挂回挂架，不放地上。

shots.section_title: 不手持工件，用夹具固定
shots.scene: 一只手扶着工件焊接，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one hand holding a metal workpiece while the other welds it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不要用手拿着工件焊。
overlay: 不手持工件，用夹具固定

shots.section_title: 不手持工件，用夹具固定
shots.scene: 【实拍】用夹钳把工件固定在焊接台上（设备不出光）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands in gloves fixing a metal workpiece to a welding table with clamps.
shots.narration: 用夹具固定，双手离开光路。

shots.section_title: 不手持工件，用夹具固定
shots.scene: 手放在工件下面，热量传过来，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand placed under a workpiece with heat waves passing through, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 手不放工件下面，热量会烫伤。

shots.section_title: 不手持工件，用夹具固定
shots.scene: 手压着靠尺切割打叉，夹钳固定靠尺打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand pressing a straight edge while cutting crossed out, and clamps holding the straight edge with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 切割时，靠尺也用夹钳固定。

shots.section_title: 不手持工件，用夹具固定
shots.scene: 停机后戴护目镜敲打零件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in safety goggles tapping a part loose with a hammer after the machine has stopped. No text.
shots.narration: 敲打零件要停机，戴好护目镜。

shots.section_title: 只从焊枪后方观察
shots.scene: 操作者站在焊枪后方看熔池
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an operator standing behind the welding torch and watching the weld pool from behind. No text.
shots.narration: 观察熔池，只站在焊枪后方。

shots.section_title: 只从焊枪后方观察
shots.scene: 侧身低头凑到焊点旁看，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person leaning sideways and ducking low beside the weld spot to look, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不侧着、不低头凑到旁边看。

shots.section_title: 反射区不站人，有人进入立即停光
shots.scene: 工件周围画出反射区，区内无人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shaded reflection zone drawn around a workpiece, nobody inside it. No text.
shots.narration: 工件周围是反射区，里面不站人。
overlay: 反射区不站人，有人进入立即停光

shots.section_title: 反射区不站人，有人进入立即停光
shots.scene: 光路方向上的纸箱和抹布被移走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cardboard box and oily rags being moved away from the beam direction. No text.
shots.narration: 激光路径上，不放易燃物。

shots.section_title: 反射区不站人，有人进入立即停光
shots.scene: 有人走进反射区，操作者松开扳机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person stepping into the reflection zone and the operator releasing the trigger at once. No text.
shots.narration: 有人走进反射区，马上停光。

shots.section_title: 运行全程一臂之内看守
shots.scene: 阿杰站在切割机旁，眼睛看着机内
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands right beside a running laser cutter, watching the work through the viewing window.
shots.narration: 运行全程，人不离机。
overlay: 运行全程一臂之内看守

shots.section_title: 运行全程一臂之内看守
shots.scene: 切割、雕刻、测试方格三个图标都连着守候的人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, cutting, engraving and a small test grid, each linked to a person standing by. No text.
shots.narration: 切割、雕刻、测试，都要守着。

shots.section_title: 运行全程一臂之内看守
shots.scene: 人和机器之间画出一臂距离
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arm's length marked between the operator and the machine, the inside of the machine in clear view. No text.
shots.narration: 站在一臂之内，看得见机内。

shots.section_title: 运行全程一臂之内看守
shots.scene: 玩手机、戴耳机、走开三个图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a phone, headphones and a person walking away, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不玩手机、不戴耳机、不走开。

shots.section_title: 运行全程一臂之内看守
shots.scene: 阿杰在旁边准备下一个设计，不时抬头看机器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sketches his next design beside the machine, glancing up at it every few seconds.
shots.narration: 准备下一件可以，眼睛常回到机器上。

shots.section_title: 易燃材料防起火
shots.scene: 纸、薄木板、亚克力三个图标冒小火苗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, paper, thin plywood and a clear plastic sheet, each with a small flame. No text.
shots.narration: 纸、薄木板、亚克力，容易着火。

shots.section_title: 易燃材料防起火
shots.scene: 灭火器挂在切割机旁边
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fire extinguisher mounted on the wall right next to the laser cutter. No text.
shots.narration: 灭火器就在旁边，要会用。

shots.section_title: 易燃材料防起火
shots.scene: 机内起小火，按下停止键，盖子保持关闭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small flame inside the machine, a hand pressing the stop button while the lid stays closed. No text.
shots.narration: 起火先按停，盖子保持关闭。

shots.section_title: 易燃材料防起火
shots.scene: 火势变大，人撤离，手机拨119
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a growing fire, people leaving the room and a phone dialling 119. No text.
shots.narration: 控制不住，撤离并拨打119。

shots.section_title: 报警和异常立即停
shots.scene: 屏幕弹出气压不足提示，手指点继续打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a low air pressure alert on a control screen, a finger tapping the continue button crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 报警提示，不能点继续了事。

shots.section_title: 报警和异常立即停
shots.scene: 没有推荐参数的材料组合，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a settings screen with an empty recommended setting slot and a crossed out cut button. No text.
shots.narration: 没有推荐参数，别硬切。

shots.section_title: 报警和异常立即停
shots.scene: 切不动：加功率、降速度打叉，按停机键
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cut that does not go through, a power dial turned up and a speed dial turned down both crossed out, a hand pressing stop. No text.
shots.narration: 切不动了，不加功率，停下来看。

shots.section_title: 报警和异常立即停
shots.scene: 焊缝没熔透，光从焊点散射出来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unfused weld spot with stray light scattering out of it, a stop hand symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 没熔透，光会散射出来，立即停。

shots.section_title: 报警和异常立即停
shots.scene: 声音、火花、气味突变，停止按钮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sudden changes in sound, sparks and smell around a machine, a hand pressing the stop button. No text.
shots.narration: 情况突然变了，就停。

shots.section_title: 报警和异常立即停
shots.scene: 阿杰向小研报告，两人查原因
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports the alarm to the female graduate student and they check the machine together.
shots.narration: 查明原因、处理好，再继续加工。

shots.section_title: 卡丝、焊枪故障：先停光再处理
shots.scene: 焊丝粘在焊嘴，手松开扳机、关掉出光开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding wire stuck at the nozzle, a hand releasing the trigger and switching off the emission enable switch. No text.
shots.narration: 卡丝粘丝，先松扳机、关出光。
overlay: 卡丝、焊枪故障：先停光再处理

shots.section_title: 卡丝、焊枪故障：先停光再处理
shots.scene: 确认不出光后剪丝；出光时手在焊嘴前打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cutting the wire after the emission lamp is off, and a hand in front of the nozzle while emitting crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 确认不出光，再剪丝清焊嘴。

shots.section_title: 卡丝、焊枪故障：先停光再处理
shots.scene: 拍打焊枪打叉，拔下电源插头，挂空白报修牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand slapping a welding torch crossed out, then a power plug pulled out and a blank repair tag hung up. No text.
shots.narration: 按键失灵，停机断电报修，别拍焊枪。

shots.section_title: 手伸进机内前停光，取件防割防烫
shots.scene: 手伸进机内前：出光灯灭、横梁停稳
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: before a hand reaches into the machine, the emission lamp is off and the gantry has come to a full stop. No text.
shots.narration: 伸手进机内前，确认停光、横梁停稳。
overlay: 手伸进机内前停光，取件防割防烫

shots.section_title: 手伸进机内前停光，取件防割防烫
shots.scene: 刚切好的零件冒着热气、边缘锋利
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: freshly cut metal parts with heat waves rising and sharp edges glinting. No text.
shots.narration: 刚切好的零件，又烫又锋利。

shots.section_title: 手伸进机内前停光，取件防割防烫
shots.scene: 等冷却后戴防割手套取件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gloved hand in cut resistant gloves lifting a cooled part out of the machine bed. No text.
shots.narration: 等冷却，戴防割手套再取件。

shots.section_title: 不靠机器，不爬工作台
shots.scene: 切割台格栅条又尖又利，人靠着机器打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sharp slats of a cutting table grid, a person leaning on the machine with a hand on the slats crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 格栅又尖又利，别靠机器，别搭手。

shots.section_title: 不靠机器，不爬工作台
shots.scene: 人爬上切割台，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person climbing onto a large cutting table, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绝不能爬上切割台。

shots.section_title: 不靠机器，不爬工作台
shots.scene: 老李站在台外用长柄工具取件清渣
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands outside the cutting table and uses a long handled tool to pull out parts and slag.
shots.narration: 取件清渣，在台外用工具。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 授权卡、点检卡、急停按钮三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an authorisation card, a checklist and an emergency stop button. No text.
shots.narration: 授权上机，开机点检，认清急停。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 枪口朝下、夹具、后方观察三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a torch pointing down, a clamp and an eye behind the torch. No text.
shots.narration: 枪口不对人，夹具固定，后方观察。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 一臂之内的人和停止按钮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person within arm's length of a machine and a hand on the stop button. No text.
shots.narration: 全程看守，有异常立即停。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一块写着空白标签的木板和一片透明塑料板挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a plain wooden board and a clear plastic sheet and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：激光加工材料与烟尘。
